title: Flock Audit Assistance flags shown on the Council RTIC slide (149 "Needs Review", a 587-search activity) and the Department's review of them; Axon, lockout and exigent-search flags
summary:
Asks for the records behind the "Audit Assistance" slide in the Police Department's Real Time Information Center presentation to Council on 2026-10-05 (produced under W013663-101526). The slide shows the Flock Audit Assistance screen with 149 activities under "Needs Review", including a "Searches Beyond 30 Day Timeframe" activity at "587 total, 31 new" (latest activity 4/27/2026 6:52:17 PM), another at "13 total, 1 new" (4/28/2026 9:01:49 AM), and a "Single-User Plate Searches" activity. The request quotes Flock's 2026-08-13 public description of Audit Assistance, "proactive lockout" and flagging of exigent searches. Default period: 2026-04-01 through production.

- Item 1: every Audit Assistance activity under the "Needs Review", "Archived" and "All" views, with the displayed fields (Activity, Related Activity, User, Plate, Total Searches, Latest Activity, Status), any reviewer note, disposition or archive date, and the view counts; the system export (CSV/XLS) if one exists.
- Item 2: for the two activities on the slide, (a) the activity detail with each underlying search's date/time, offense type, reason, case number and networks or cameras, and (b) any record of review, disposition, archiving, notes, suspension or lockout, notice to the user or a supervisor, or referral.
- Item 3: the record of when Audit Assistance was enabled and by which account (e.g. Flock event-log entries, Flock's notice, or the settings page), and any record designating who reviews activities.
- Item 4: any record of review of an Audit Assistance activity, including in the Policy 463.10 monthly audit memoranda. Quotes Policy 463.10 and notes that a "no responsive records" answer would mean no record of reviewing any flagged activity, including the 587-search one.
- Item 5: any Axon Evidence or Axon Fusus report or flag of anomalous ALPR search activity (Fleet 3 or other Axon ALPR data), and its review.
- Item 6: any record of a "proactive lockout" suspension and its review and outcome, and of whether and when proactive lockout was enabled.
- Item 7: any flag or review record for an emergency or exigent search that bypassed the case code, case number or offense type requirement.

Electronic records are requested in their native format (Gov. Code § 7922.570), with withheld portions marked in place per field and the legal authority identified (Gov. Code § 7922.540).

policy_promises.quote: It is the responsibility of the ALPR Committee Captain or the authorized designee to ensure an audit is conducted of ALPR data searches at least monthly for internal ALPR users and quarterly for external CA public agency users. The audit shall be documented in the form of an internal department memorandum to the Chief of Police. ... After review by the Chief of Police, the memorandum and any associated documentation shall be filed and retained.
policy_promises.tests: Whether any monthly audit memorandum or other Department record shows review of the activities the Flock system flagged for review, including the 587-search activity.

policy_promises.quote: The agency shall make the information available in any electronic format in which it holds the information.
policy_promises.tests: Whether the Audit Assistance lists and activity details are produced as the system export rather than a rendering.

policy_promises.quote: A response to a written request for inspection or copies of public records that includes a determination that the request is denied, in whole or in part, shall be in writing.
policy_promises.tests: Whether withheld portions are marked in place per field with the authority for each.

prior_pra_refs.note: Produced the 2026-10-05 Real Time Information Center presentation whose "Audit Assistance" slide this request quotes.

filed_because: The Department showed Council a Flock screen with 149 search activities flagged "Needs Review", one of them 587 searches for a plate outside a 30-day window. This request asks for the full flag list, the detail behind the two visible activities, when the feature was turned on, and whatever record shows anyone at the Department reviewed the flags, as Policy 463.10's monthly audits would require. It also asks for the comparable Axon flags and any lockout or exigent-search flags.
notes:
Filed 2026-10-24 (portal receipt 10/24/2026 10:52 PM, a Saturday); auto-acknowledged and forwarded to department(s). 10-day statutory determination due 2026-11-03.

2026-11-03 response (Kelly O'Keefe, Police Technical Services Administrator), on the statutory due date: "Due to the large number of records which are associated with this request, the City will send you records on a rolling production basis." An initial batch was released; next update no later than 2026-11-17.

The batch is one file, `event-log_Audit_Assistance.csv`, a Flock event-log export (Timestamp, User, Event Type, Entity Type, Entity Details, Event Id) with a single row: Steve Casazza, "update", "organization", "Audit Assistance: Disabled -> Enabled", at 2026-04-23T17:10:43Z (10:10 AM PDT). That answers the enablement part of Item 3: Audit Assistance was switched on 2026-04-23, four days before the 4/27/2026 latest activity on the 587-search "Needs Review" item shown on the Council slide. Nothing yet for the activity lists (Item 1), the two activity details (Item 2), the reviewer designation (rest of Item 3), review records (Item 4), Axon flags (Item 5), lockouts (Item 6) or exigent-search flags (Item 7).

2026-11-17 at 8:56 AM, the extended date: closed (O'Keefe). "We have made a good faith and diligent effort to complete your request, in which responsive records have been collected. ... The City has completed its response to your request and now considers this record request W013721-102426 closed." Two files were added: a response letter dated 2026-11-17, signed by O'Keefe, and `Audit_Assistance_Log_Redacted.pdf`. The letter opens: "In accordance with Government Code § 7922.525, a legal review of your request has been completed. Any redactions or exemptions cited in the Department's response have been reviewed and authorized by the signatory of this letter."

The letter's answers:
- Item 1: "Responsive records are available in the GovQA portal. Portions of your request are being withheld pursuant to Government Code section 7923.600, as they constitute law-enforcement investigative records."
- Item 2: "(a) The portal does not create static records, and we have no means to identify the searches visible in the screenshot. (b) No responsive records."
- Item 3: "Responsive records are available in the GovQA portal." The only Item 3 record is the 11/3 event-log row. Nothing designating who reviews activities was produced.
- Item 4: "The records provided in Item 1 constitute responsive records to this request. All activities marked as archived have undergone administrative review. Each review contains information regarding the law enforcement investigation associated with the identified license plate. Investigative information contained within these records has been withheld pursuant to Government Code Section 7923.600, as it constitutes exempt law enforcement investigative information."
- Items 5, 6 and 7: "No responsive records."

The log is seven pages of screen captures of Flock's Organization Audit, Audit Assistance list, with every filter set to All and the rows sorted by Latest Activity, newest first. It is an image-only PDF. No CSV or XLS export was produced. The heading reads "183 Activities" and the pages run rows 1 to 183. Columns: Activity, Related Activity, Role, User, Plate, Total Searches, Latest Activity, Status. The Plate column is blacked out on every row, and the boxes carry no label. User names and roles are shown.
- Status: 7 rows are "Needs Review" (the tab reads "Audit Assistance (7)") and 176 are "Archived". The Needs Review rows are the six newest, with latest activity from 11/10 to 11/15/2026, and one from 11/5/2026.
- Latest Activity runs from early January 2026 (the oldest row reads 1/3/2026) to 11/15/2026 at 5:02:27 AM, so the list reaches back before the 2026-04-23 enablement. The screen's banner says: "Audit Assistance applies filters to already existing data in your audits. All records surfaced below are for administrators' informational purposes and do not reflect any findings or conclusions by Flock or your agency."
- Activity is "Searches Beyond 30 Day Timeframe", "Single-User Plate Searches" or both. Related Activity is blank, "Repeated Narrow Timeframes" or "Wildcard Plate Search". Roles shown: Field Ops / Communications - Dispatch, CIB / CRU, Real Time Information Center (RTCC), Supervisors, Admin and "Unknown role".
- Largest totals: 788 (latest activity 3/18/2026), 355 (8/17/2026), 236 (5/27/2026), 177 (2/17/2026), 139 (6/25/2026), 131 (2/24/2026) and 110 (3/19/2026).
- Neither activity on the Council slide appears in the list as the slide shows it. No row has a latest activity of 4/27/2026 6:52:17 PM or 4/28/2026 9:01:49 AM (the list has nothing between 4/24/2026 6:01:02 PM and 5/7/2026 2:22:08 PM), and no row shows 587 total. The one row above 587 is the 788-search row, whose latest activity, 3/18/2026, is earlier than the slide's.
- The three oldest rows, on the last page, show a small icon at the end of the row. No note text was produced.

Not produced: any reviewer note, disposition or archive date (Item 1); the searches behind any activity (Item 2a); the review records, which the letter says exist for every archived activity and are withheld whole under § 7923.600 (Item 4); and any audit memorandum that mentions an Audit Assistance activity (Item 4). The list has no review or archive date column, so the production does not show when any activity was reviewed.
